content: Table TABREF23 shows that when we change the English typology order to SOV or OSV order, the performance on Korean is improved and worsen on English and Chinese, but very slightly. The results show that the typology manipulation on the training set has little influence. It is possible that multi-BERT normalizes the typology order of different languages to some extent.
